behavior: With no `step` prop, the buttons and the keys change the value by 1, and the hidden input has `step="any"`, so the form accepts each number. A `step` prop of the developer is also the constraint of the form: with `:min="0"`, `:step="1"` makes the form refuse `0.11`. Base UI checks a step of 1 when the developer gives no step, so with `min={0}` its form refuses `0.11`.
